messages:
maria: Found a broken JS example in Streaming guide causing an infinite loop. Opened hotfix PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 :warning:
kevin: Ack. Any repro steps? Impact?
docs-bot: PR #4999 opened by maria  CI: tests OK, lint minor. Staging build queued (build-2026-03-16-09).
maria: Repro: paste snippet into Node REPL with streaming enabled. Bug is `for await` used directly on stream. Fix swaps to `for await (const chunk of stream.chunks())`.
ashley: TS example also had a confusing `autoFlush` comment; I removed it in the PR.
samir: I'll draft a short erratum blurb for the v0.9.7 changelog and add a workaround (use `readableStreamDefaultReader()` or `stream.chunks()`).
leo: Proposed rollout: merge, canary to staging 30m, smoke in Node14/18, then prod + CDN purge. I'll run publish and share purge ID.
kevin: Prepare support canned reply and note in known-issues.
maria: Fixing lint and will squash then merge. Tagging hotfix/docs/streaming-4999.
docs-bot: Staging smoke: 12/12 passed. Merge queued.
samir: Erratum draft pushed to PR description and changelog; will add commit sha after merge.
leo: Standing by at canary time. Rollback plan ready (`git revert <sha>` + CDN rollback).
maria: After prod push we'll post an update in #general and pin erratum to v0.9.7 changelog. Thanks all.
